Sonnet 5.5 by default (features/sonnet-default-caching.clan, 2026-10-13): $2/$10 per MTok against Opus 4.6's $5/$25, and its 512-token cache minimum lets the system prompt cache, where Opus 4.6's 4096 cached none. Effort low is the nearest to Opus 4.6, which ran without thinking; the brief writers think at medium. The schema goes in the prompt: Bedrock does not enforce it for the 5.5 models. Measured 2026-10-04 on 32 real seed requests: Opus 4.6 found the most verified facts (143 vs 131 for Opus 5.5 high, 106 low); a purpose that does worse on Sonnet goes back to opus-4.6 here.
